_comment: Qwen2.5-VL vision tower. `params` field name = the bound name the DSL / weights.json reference; `from` paths index the VERBATIM HF config.json's nested `vision_config` block (the configs here carry it byte-for-byte). Embed dim is spelled `hidden_size` (not Qwen2-VL's `embed_dim`); the SwiGLU MLP width is `intermediate_size`, zero-padded to the next multiple of 8 for the cuBLAS bf16 GEMM K (`__pad_to_mult8__` in weights.json). The block MLP weights key off `vision_intermediate_size_padded`, so — matching the legacy derivation — no `vision_mlp_hidden` bound is declared. ORDER MATTERS: `expr` entries read bounds that earlier entries defined. Qwen2.5-VL vision blocks hardcode 1e-6 (transformers / mlx-vlm) and the macro default is 1e-6 too — stated here for the record; the per-checkpoint flat override still wins.
